title: 文档写作与报告
html:
文档写作与报告

概述

本章面向书面表达，分为文档类型、写作结构、报告常用句式、邮件写作四个部分。它解决的是"把内容写成规范文档"的问题，从选择文体到组织结构再到具体句式都有覆盖。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，写作部分可直接作为模板参考。建议先熟悉文档类型与结构，再套用报告和邮件的常用句式，逐步形成自己的书面表达习惯。

文档类型

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
specification n. 规格说明 technical specification, product spec
documentation n. 文档 API documentation, project documentation
proposal n. 提案 project proposal, submit a proposal
memo n. 备忘录 internal memo, send a memo
guideline n. 指南 coding guidelines, follow guidelines
template n. 模板 document template, use a template

听说例句

A: Do we have API documentation for this service? B: Yes, it's in the wiki. I also wrote a technical specification for the new endpoints.

A: Should I draft a proposal for the new architecture? B: That would be great. Use the project proposal template and follow our documentation guidelines.

写作表达

  • The technical specification provides a detailed overview of the system architecture and data flow.
  • All team members are expected to follow the coding guidelines outlined in the project documentation.

写作结构

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
introduction n. 引言 brief introduction, in the introduction
overview n. 概览 project overview, high-level overview
section n. 章节 next section, previous section
appendix n. 附录 see appendix, detailed in appendix
reference n. 参考 for reference, reference material
abstract n. 摘要 executive abstract, brief abstract

听说例句

A: How should I structure this design doc? B: Start with an overview, then break it into sections: problem statement, proposed solution, and trade-offs. Put the data in the appendix.

A: Should I include an introduction? B: Keep it brief. The abstract should be enough for stakeholders who don't need the full details.

写作表达

  • This section provides a high-level overview of the migration strategy and its expected outcomes.
  • Detailed performance benchmarks are available in the appendix for reference.

报告常用句式

表达 含义 场景
The purpose of this document is to... 本文档旨在... 开头
This report covers... 本报告涵盖... 范围
As shown in Figure/Table X... 如图/表X所示... 引用数据
In summary... 总结来说... 收尾
It is recommended that... 建议... 给出建议
Further details can be found in... 更多详情请参阅... 引用来源

听说例句

A: How do I start the quarterly report? B: Open with "The purpose of this report is to summarize Q1 progress." Then cover each area in a separate section.

A: Should I include recommendations? B: Yes. End with "It is recommended that..." and list the top three action items.

写作表达

  • The purpose of this document is to outline the technical approach for the upcoming platform migration.
  • As shown in Table 3, the average response time improved by 35% after the optimization.

邮件写作

表达 含义 场景
I'm writing to... 我写信是为了... 开头目的
Please find attached... 请查看附件... 发送附件
Could you please confirm...? 能否请您确认...？ 请求确认
I wanted to follow up on... 我想跟进一下... 跟进
Looking forward to your reply. 期待您的回复 结尾
Best regards / Kind regards 此致敬礼 署名

听说例句

A: How should I follow up on that unanswered email? B: Keep it short. Say "I wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding the Q2 timeline. Could you please confirm the dates?"

A: Is "Best regards" too formal? B: It's standard for professional emails. Use "Thanks" or "Cheers" for casual internal communication.

写作表达

  • I'm writing to provide an update on the status of the data center migration project.
  • Please find attached the revised project timeline for your review. Looking forward to your feedback.
